name: Add products and complete a demo checkout
description: Verifies a shopper can add an item, change quantity and finish the clearly labelled demo checkout.
steps: Tap Add to cart on Everyday Wireless Earbuds
Open the cart and increase its quantity to 2
Continue to checkout and confirm the demo order
expected: The cart shows two earbuds with the correct total, then a demo order confirmation appears with an order ID and a note that no real order was sent.

name: Search and filter the product catalog
description: Verifies search narrows the catalog and category filters show matching products.
steps: Verify Classic Cotton Hoodie is shown
Clear search and select the Home category
expected: The hoodie appears for the search, and the Home category displays home products only.

name: Keep the shopping cart after a page refresh
description: Verifies the prototype keeps cart contents on the same device after a page reload.
steps: Add Insulated Travel Bottle to the cart
expected: The cart still contains one Insulated Travel Bottle after refresh.

name: Prevent checkout when the cart is empty
description: Verifies an empty cart presents a continue-shopping action rather than an order action.
steps: Open the cart without adding products
expected: The cart says it is waiting and offers Continue shopping; no checkout button or order is available.
